items.title: What next for Nifty after a gap-up open on Wed? Analysts decode strategy
items.description: Ponmudi of Enrich Money reckons that the Nifty is likely to maintain a positive near-term bias, while some consolidation may emerge following the sharp recent rally.

items.title: Festive demand, export recovery drive auto sector growth, says MOFSL
items.description: The medium-term sector outlook remains favourable, supported by steady volume growth, product launches, improving exports and a gradual recovery in rural demand.

items.title: Hindalco, Airtel among 2 stock recommendations by Kotak's Shrikant Chouhan

items.title: PB Fintech: Retailers buy, FPIs turn wary in Q2; who got right end of deal?
